title: Add 4-level MMS convergence test [2,4,8,16]
objective: Extend MMS convergence study from 3 levels [2,3,4] to 4 levels with proper 2x refinement ratios [2,4,8,16], validating L2 rate >= 2.0 and H1 rate >= 1.0 per 08-VERIFICATION.md section 4.2.

plan_assets.asset_description: MMS convergence specification with mesh levels and rate criteria

scope: Add test_mms_4level_convergence using run_mms_convergence(lam=1.0, mu=1.0, mesh_levels=[2,4,8,16])
implementation_steps: Read existing MMS tests in test_convergence.py
Use existing run_mms_convergence and check_convergence_rate infrastructure
If 16^3 is prohibitively slow, fallback to [2,4,8]
deliverables: Test passes with L2 >= 2.0 and H1 >= 1.0
acceptance_criteria: Test uses 4 mesh levels with 2x refinement ratios
risks: 16^3 mesh (4913 nodes) may be very slow in pure numpy. Fallback: use [2,4,8] (still proper 2x ratios).

commands.command: uv run pytest packages/mechdsl-core/tests/ -m 'not slow and not gpu and not e2e' -q

completion_notes: Class-scoped fixture avoids redundant FEM solves, matching TestTaskP3T3 pattern
